notes: hash_rate_hps is centered on ~0.98 ZH/s. bitops_per_hash is a low-level double-SHA-256 trial conversion; it is intentionally broad because ASIC-level gate sharing and the exact 'bit operation' definition matter.

Power is site/system-scale for accelerator installations, not just chip TDP. ops_per_joule_at_peak is tensor-op throughput efficiency; utilization discounts peak specs to average realized operation rate.
A residual non-AI data-centre category. It converts facility power to IT power via PUE, applies a logic-compute fraction, then converts logic joules to one-bit primitive operations.
Network power is dominated by access and transmission infrastructure. Only the logic-processing fraction is counted as computation.
A broad installed-base category. Average logic power is averaged over wall-clock time, not just powered-on time.
Device count includes smartphones plus tablets/wearables. Average logic power is low because most devices are idle most of the day.

A direct aggregate placeholder for MCUs, vehicles, appliances, industrial PLCs, sensors, payment terminals, building controls, etc. This is the least satisfying bucket and should be split in the next revision.
TVs, streaming boxes, set-top boxes, image pipelines, security cameras, and similar fixed-function media hardware.
